slides.texte_overlay:
How to get through winter
without losing your energy
Get outside in daylight every day. Even cloudy winter light helps your mood and sleep. A twenty-minute walk at lunch makes a real difference.
Keep training, even when it's dark and cold. Winter is when many men stop, and spring is when they regret it. Lift indoors, run with a light.
Make your home warm and bright. Good lamps, a tidy space, a few plants. A cosy home makes long evenings feel like a pleasure, not a prison.
See friends on purpose. Winter makes it easy to stay in. Plan a weekly dinner, a game night or a sauna session to keep your social life alive.
Before: winter evenings felt long and empty. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and they became my favourite time to learn.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: winter evenings felt long and empty. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. They became my favourite time to learn.

slides.texte_overlay: Eat warm, real food. Soups, stews, roasted vegetables. Good winter cooking keeps you healthy and makes dark evenings feel comforting.
Plan something for the end of winter. A trip, a race, a project. Having something to look forward to makes the cold months go faster.
